strategy._comment: Oct 1: quarter caps for the first live day. Kelly 0.5, min_edge 0.05, min_roc 0.05 chosen from sims calibrated to the real Cup (MM within ~1 pt of anchors): break-even if the Cup never lags, same profit as before if it does, far smaller worst case.
